requirements.text: University graduate in Business Administration, Economics, Management or a related field
Ability to manage multiple high-priority projects simultaneously
Demonstrated problem-solving skills through previous full-time roles or internships
Proactive, hands-on, and driven by a strong getting things done mindset
Strong communication skills in written and spoken English
Based in Munich or willing to relocate there
Experience identifying process improvements and building scalable systems or operations
Experience supporting market, competitor, and pricing analyses or business cases
Experience in business development or commercial strategy

resumes.text:
Felix Aurand
Munich, Germany

Summary
Economist with a Bachelor of Science in Economics and excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities. Proactive, hands-on and driven by a strong getting things done mindset. Fluent in English and German. Holds a valid EU work permit and relocated to Munich in 2025.

Experience
Business Analyst, Veldmann Insurance AG, Cologne (2021 to 2025)
- Ran three overlapping internal projects at the same time, each with its own deadline and steering committee.
- Compared competitor price lists and built the pricing model for a new product line, which the board adopted.
- Redesigned the invoice approval steps for the claims department, cutting processing time from 10 days to 2.
- Produced monthly reporting packs for a 1,500-person corporate insurance division.

Intern, Brenner Logistics, Hamburg (summer 2020)
- Supported route planning and cost analysis for the operations team.

Intern, Kessel Retail, Hanover (2019)
- Assisted the store network team with sales forecasts and store opening plans.

Education
Bachelor of Science in Economics, Lindau University of Economics, 2021

Skills
Business analysis, forecasting, pricing, Excel, PowerPoint, project management, English (fluent), German (native)

Sophie Brandauer
Hamburg, Germany

Summary
Business graduate with excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities and a clear interest in finance and operations. Fluent in English. I am not planning to relocate to Munich at this stage.

Experience
Completed two internships, at a bank and at a marketing agency, in 2020 and 2021.

Administrative Clerk, Hansestadt City Administration, Hamburg (2021 to 2025)
- Handled permit applications and budget files for a public agency of about 2,000 employees.
- Reorganized the monthly reporting workflow for the finance team so the books close in three days instead of nine.
- Answered citizen queries about tax and housing forms, keeping a record of every case.

Intern, Lindner Bank, Hamburg (2021)
- Supported the investment team with client reporting and data entry.

Intern, Pixelwerk Marketing, Hamburg (2020)
- Assisted campaign planning and tracked project budgets for two small clients.

Education
Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration, Ostsee University, 2022
Student union events coordinator (2020 to 2022): Coordinated three university-wide events in the same term, each with a separate budget and volunteer team.

Skills
Microsoft Office, reporting, budgeting, record keeping, English (fluent), German (native)

Dana Kowalczyk

Summary
Registered nurse with eight years of experience on busy hospital wards. Calm under pressure, patient-focused and organised. Fluent in English and Polish.

Experience
Registered Nurse, Lindenhof General Hospital, Essen (2018 to present)
- Care for a ward of 28 patients per shift, coordinating with doctors, physiotherapists and families.
- Solved staffing shortages on night shifts for eight years, keeping wards fully covered through holidays and sick leave.
- Trained new nursing staff on medication safety and patient handover procedures.
- Lead the ward safety checks and document every incident report in full.

Registered Nurse, St. Anna Clinic, Essen (2014 to 2018)
- Worked across surgical and recovery units, supporting post-operative patients through the first 48 hours.
- Maintained patient records and made sure handover between shifts was accurate.

Education
Diploma in Nursing Science, Danube Health Academy, 2014
First-aid and emergency care certificate, renewed annually

Skills
Patient care, medication management, emergency response, team coordination, English (fluent), Polish (native)
